name: Goose Fat
imageAlt: rendered pure traditional goose fat in a glass container
description: Goose fat is a premium bioavailable animal lipid matrix with high thermodynamic stability. Its profile, rich in monounsaturated oleic acid (similar to olive oil), serves as an efficient metabolic fuel and a culinary transport system that enhances the systemic absorption of lipophilic micronutrients.
macroIntro: A pure, high-density lipid matrix (100% fat) isolated from proteins and carbohydrates.
microIntro: A lipophilic matrix rich in oleic acid and stabilizing tocopherols, reinforcing cellular membrane integrity.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: Maximal energy density providing a sustained-release fuel resource.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Optimized lipid profile: ~33% sat, ~55% monounsat (oleic), ~12% polyunsat.

microNutrients.name: Oleic Acid (Omega-9)
microNutrients.description: Monounsaturated fraction supporting endothelial health and membrane elasticity.

microNutrients.name: Linoleic Acid (Omega-6)
microNutrients.description: Polyunsaturated tract assisting in tissue regeneration.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol)
microNutrients.description: Antioxidant protecting lipid double bonds from oxidative cleavage.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin K2 (Menaquinone)
microNutrients.description: Supports calcium distribution away from vascular tissues.

microNutrients.name: Dietary Cholesterol
microNutrients.description: Sterol precursor for steroid hormones and bile acid synthesis.

healthBenefits: Cardiovascular Support: High oleic acid content aids in optimizing lipid ratios.
Thermal Resilience: High smoke point (~200°C) prevents toxic polymer formation during cooking.
Bioavailability Vehicle: Essential for the absorption of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).
Membrane Integrity: Provides structural lipids for phospholipid bilayer maintenance.
Ketogenic Efficiency: Pure triglyceride profile drives stable ketogenesis.
precautionsIntro: Considerations for caloric density and oxidative stability:
precautions: Caloric Loading: Extremely high energy density requires portion monitoring to avoid surplus.
Saturated Fat Limits: Contains ~33% saturated fats; modulate intake if managing hyperlipidemia.
Auto-oxidation: Store in a cool, dark place to prevent the formation of aldehydes and epoxides.
